name: release-room
description: Ships releases: what goes in, the checks before it, the approval to deploy and the notes after it.
welcome: Each release gets a thread in #releases. Checks report to #checks, the go or no-go is decided in #approvals by the people who own it, and #notes is what users read.

sections.name: Prepare
sections.rules: Name the version and the commit in every post.

sections.name: Ship
sections.rules: Nothing deploys without an approval in #approvals.

channels.name: releases
channels.purpose: One thread per release: scope, owner and status

channels.name: checks
channels.purpose: Test and check results for a release
channels.rules: Post the result, the version checked and a link to the details.

channels.name: approvals
channels.purpose: Go or no-go for a deploy, decided by people
channels.rules: Only the release owners approve; say what you checked.
